title: Which Box Hides the Puppy?
youtube_title: 🐶 Which Box Is the Puppy Hiding In? #Shorts
youtube_description: Can YOU find the hidden puppy? Watch to see if you guessed right! 🐾📦 #Kidify #KidsYouTube #GuessingGame #PuppyShorts #FunForKids #Shorts

scenes.narration: A puppy is hiding in one of these three boxes — but which one?
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the yellow box? Pick your answer now!
Three… two… one… let's find out!
You open the red box and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack, wrong box!
scenes.visual_prompt: open red box rubber duck inside

scenes.narration: You try the blue box and… it's a giant pile of socks! Ewww, not today!
scenes.visual_prompt: open blue box pile of socks

scenes.narration: That means the yellow box is… YES! There's the puppy! You found it!
scenes.visual_prompt: cute puppy inside open yellow box

scenes.narration: Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — it's even trickier!
